<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1149
Claimant:
Sarah Stevens
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
01/12/2025
Claim received for a side impact at an intersection, with the insured's vehicle struck on the driver's side by another
vehicle. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all futrher contact is being routed through the attorney's office.
01/22/2025
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver involved is listed as a named driver, and the loss falls within the
coverage period with nothing suggesting the damage predates it.
01/28/2025
Obtained statements from the other driver and two independent witnesses, all of whom describe the collision
happening as the claimant reported it. Scene photos are consistent with the vehicle damage and the direction of
impact.
01/29/2025
The claimant reports a wrist fracture from the crash. Medical records reviewed so far show the injury is a plausible
result of an impact of this type, and no prior injury to the same area appears in the history on file.
05/09/2025
Treatment followed a usual course, with casting, follow-up visits, and therapy, and the treating notes show steday
improvement that has tapered off over recent weeks.
06/11/2025
The claimant has since added a few smaller details about the event, but the core account has not changed from the
first statement taken through counsel.
06/16/2025
It is still unclear from the materials on hand exactly where the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the moment of
impact, and the question is noted for follow-up with counsel.
08/20/2025
While checking prior records on the vehicle, found a report from an earlier accident showing similar major damage to
the same area, which was never submitted to us at the time. The current claim presents that damage as new, so the
discrepancy has been flagged for further review.
08/28/2025
Referred the file for a supervisor review to address the prior-damage record and the open question about seating
position before any settlement position is taken. Counsel will be notified of the review and asked for the outstanding
information.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
